purpose: Sanity fixtures for a host RDKit adapter; not a validated ADMET or biological-activity benchmark.
reference_basis: Canonical small-molecule identities and elementary formula/descriptor invariants; descriptor expectations are version-sensitive.
limitations: These are parser/descriptor sanity checks, not an independently curated chemical benchmark.
RDKit version and descriptor implementation must be recorded with every run.
No protonation, tautomer, stereoisomer, conformer, biological activity, ADMET, PK/PD or clinical inference is validated.
A passing fixture does not validate the Android chemistry runtime.
